scenarios.requires: Two separate verified browser identities in two countries; at least Trade and Finance Office scopes, including Buyer Finance approval where required; server-side deny on wrong country, Office and revoked membership.
scenarios.missing: World Web has fixture Office selection, not authenticated server sessions or an authorized browser command route.

scenarios.requires: Browser calls a classified read API under each identity; Country/Office fields and WorldVersion originate from server projections; cross-scope reads are denied.
scenarios.missing: World Web renders local projection fixtures and does not call the read API.

scenarios.requires: Real bilateral command is submitted from authorized browser sessions; final success and failure receipts are retrieved by command ID and reconciled with WorldVersion and server state.
scenarios.missing: The command page uses a local mock transport/receipt; the browser has no actual command submission endpoint.

scenarios.requires: After actual command and projection updates, browser refresh, lost connection, reauthentication and out-of-order delivery never display a lower accepted WorldVersion or wrong-scope cached data.
scenarios.missing: No live private channel, authorized UI cache adapter or real command/projection sequence is wired.
